desc: Establish that a subarray’s answer is the number of connected components of its set of distinct values, equivalently `#present values - #present adjacent value pairs`.
Derive the right-endpoint contribution: for fixed `R`, a value contributes `last[x]` left endpoints and an adjacent pair contributes `min(last[x], last[x+1])` left endpoints.
Implement and validate the O(N) sweep in Python, updating only the two affected adjacent-pair contributions per element.
